title: Deterministic skeleton-aware weights for the implicit welded surface (MVP-critical)
description:
## Summary
Build a deterministic, skeleton-aware, build-time weighting model that authors per-vertex `VertexInfluence[]` for the implicit welded surface (Body + all SDF limb metaballs welded into one `GeometryType.Implicit` mesh). This is the deferred hard case TSK-0077 scoped out and is the MVP-critical enabler: real generated creature limbs are welded into this surface, so idle/walk is undemonstrable without it.

## Scope
- Consume the resolved rest-space implicit mesh vertices + `ResolvedCreatureSnapshot`/`SkeletonSnapshot`.
- Model: nearest point on eligible bone segment(s)/capsule axis, smoothly blended near joints; select up to 4 local influences and normalize deterministically. Restrict eligible influences to the vertex's source-part resolved semantic chain + nearby chain segments. Do NOT use nearest-bone-center Euclidean distance alone (bent chains).
- Resolve welded-surface mirrored contributions to mirrored semantic bones via `SemanticBoneResolver`/`MirrorUtility` reflection; no mirror-identity rediscovery; do not alter `RigBindingMetadata`.
- Weights are pose-independent build-time pure data on generation output; cached/precomputed; never recomputed per frame.
- Preserve the shared `SkeletonSnapshot.Capture` bone-index ordering invariant with the adapter (0132) and rigid weighting (0130).

## Acceptance Criteria
- Fixture matrix passes: straight limb, single bend, branch point, vertex near a joint seam, mirrored limb, and the generated Body/welded surface.
- Rest-pose equivalence and known-pose deformation match the `LinearBlendSkinning.Deform` oracle; <=4 influences/vertex; normalized; deterministic repeated generation.
- Mirror-consistent; invariant under stable canonical ordering and Unity scene order.
- No weight calculation during pose application; welded-surface mirror identity exercised (closes the deferred TSK-0054/TSK-0077 mirror gap on real geometry).

## Validation
Pure Tests.Runtime (headless; pure math): synthetic resolved-part fixtures for the matrix above + parity against LinearBlendSkinning. Real `GeneratedCreature` implicit surface PlayMode parity when Unity is available. dotnet Runtime + Tests.Runtime build and git diff --check.

## Findings
Confirmed (source/HEAD e88ba5d): generated implicit surface is ONE welded marching-cubes mesh (`SourcePartId=""`) containing body + limb surfaces; no per-vertex part attribution; no weighting code exists anywhere. LinearBlendSkinning doc explicitly leaves the welded Body surface out of scope until this model is validated.

## Blockers
Needs a resolved skeleton + rest vertices; pure math so headless-testable. The welded mesh has no per-primitive memory, so weights are geometric (segment nearest-point), the accepted documented approach.

## Next Step
Co-schedule with the SkinnedMeshRenderer adapter (0132); do NOT gate behind rigid mesh-asset weighting (0130). This is the primary MVP weighting task.

comments.body:
R1 implementation landed (working tree, not committed). New: Assets/Scripts/Runtime/Animation/Binding/ImplicitSurfaceWeightAuthoring.cs (pure) + Assets/Scripts/Tests/Runtime/ImplicitSurfaceWeightAuthoringTests.cs.

MODEL (design decisions to review):
- Welded surface has no per-vertex part attribution (SourcePartId=""), so weights are GEOMETRIC nearest-point-on-segment, the accepted documented approach. Eligibility = welded rig segment bones (Body spine + limb segment bones). No fabricated per-part attribution.
- BoneSegmentInfluence = bone segment [Position,EndPosition] + influence Radius. Radius is morphology (Body sample radius / limb thickness), NOT on Bone => supplied by caller; the morphology->radius bridge is the TSK-0132 adapter's job. DefaultInfluenceRadius=0.5 fallback keeps the skeleton-only helper total.
- Per vertex: weight = max(0, 1 - d/(Radius*RadiusScale=3))^2, d = closest point on segment (NOT bone center => bent chains bind correctly, joint seams blend). Select top-4 by (weight desc, BoneIndex asc) => deterministic and invariant to segment/vertex ordering. Normalize by selected sum. No eligible influence or non-finite vertex/non-positive radius => DomainException.
- Mirror: SkeletonSnapshot already holds BOTH authored + reflected chains (SkeletonInferrer); nearest-segment auto-binds mirrored-side verts to mirrored bones. NO mirror-identity rediscovery; RigBindingMetadata untouched.
- Ordering contract locked+documented: VertexInfluence.BoneIndex = index into SkeletonSnapshot.Capture (BFS id-sorted) order; exposed via BuildSegmentInfluences. Consumed by TSK-0132/0130.
- Build-time only; Author is the sole weight computation; never run during pose application.

VALIDATION:
- dotnet build ProceduralCreature.Runtime.csproj --no-restore: SUCCESS 0 err/0 warn.
- dotnet build ProceduralCreature.Tests.Runtime.csproj --no-restore: SUCCESS 0 err/0 warn.
- git diff --check: clean (exit 0).
- Unity console: 0 errors after auto-compile of new files.
- BLOCKER (honest): actual PlayMode fixture execution NOT yet run — Unity MCP bridge returned "Connection closed before reading expected bytes" (shared editor held by concurrent rounds); refused to run a disruptive domain-reload/play-mode batch over them. dotnet test has no NUnit adapter in these Unity-generated csproj (no-op, exit 0, no tests). Residual risk: fixture-matrix logic is compiled but not yet executed; needs the focused PlayMode run of ImplicitSurfaceWeightAuthoringTests.

Next step: run focused Unity PlayMode fixture (ImplicitSurfaceWeightAuthoringTests) when the shared editor is free; then mark Done.

comments.body: Sprint R1 validation (orchestrator independently re-ran). Implemented ImplicitSurfaceWeightAuthoring.cs (pure build-time segment-axis weighting core) + ImplicitSurfaceWeightAuthoringTests.cs. dotnet Runtime + Tests.Runtime build 0 err/0 warn; git diff --check clean; Unity compiles 0 errors. Focused PlayMode fixture ProceduralCreature.Tests.Runtime.ImplicitSurfaceWeightAuthoringTests: 10/10 passed (bent chain binds correct segment not bone center; branch blends Body+two limbs; generated Body surface all vertices valid+deterministic; mirrored limb binds mirrored bone with no identity rediscovery; straight-limb rigid + rest-pose LBS roundtrip; single-bend known-pose only distal moves; ordering-independence; no-eligible + non-finite throws; BuildSegmentInfluences bone-ordering contract stable across insertion order). Locked shared bind-index ordering contract (VertexInfluence.BoneIndex = SkeletonSnapshot.Capture order) for TSK-0132/0130. Mirror via skeleton-reflected chain (no RigBindingMetadata change). No per-frame weight calc (build-time pure data). Whole-creature SMR-vs-LBS parity is the TSK-0132 gate, not this task.
